name: Difference Operations
justification: Satisfying divisibility aha with a one-line check; perfect race problem.
solution_sketch: a_1 never changes, and induction shows each a_i can reach 0 iff a_1 | a_i (subtracting a_{i-1}=a_1-multiples keeps values multiples of a_1). Answer YES iff a_1 divides every a_i.
